# emotion bearer

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:emotionBearer`](gmeow-emotionBearer.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/emotionBearer>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/affect`](../../slices/affect.md)

The agent in whom this emotion inheres. Functional and mandatory (SHACL): an intrinsic mode has exactly one bearer (the [`intentBearer`](gmeow-intentBearer.md) pattern).
